The Valley of the Queens is a vast necropolis concealing some of Egypt's most miraculous tombs and powerful women; now, investigators use cutting-edge tech to explore lost tunnels and uncover the enigmatic secrets behind these ancient pharaohs.

title: King Tut: A Century of Secrets
description: The world's leading Egyptologists are on a quest to uncover the secrets of Howard Carter's history-making discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb on the 100th anniversary of its discovery.

Surrounded by a mysterious trench, only one Egyptian pyramid was ever constructed to look like it floats on water; experts decode the ancient secrets of the pharaoh that are locked inside its hidden tunnels.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E05 — Terror in the Torture Tower
The Tower of London is a centuries-old castle with a grisly past; using cutting-edge methods, experts investigate this engineering marvel and how it transformed into an infamous prison steeped in blood and intrigue.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E07 — Secrets of the Sunken Empire
The secrets of the world's oldest sunken city are lost to history, but hi-tech underwater archaeology answers questions that books cannot; experts explore sunken ruins and reveal new discoveries about one of the first great empires.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Towie Ball
Containing intricately carved concentric circles, the Towie Ball is one of the finest Neolithic stoneworks ever discovered; using cutting-edge imaging technology, experts investigate the purpose behind this 5,000-year-old black stone mystery.

title: Strangest Things
description:
Phineas Gage's Skull
The shattered skull of a 19th century railway worker is now one of the most astonishing objects in the history of medical science; experts explore this traumatic injury to reveal how it changed the field of neuroscience.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E10 — Mystery of Spacetime
Spacetime is the secret structure that controls our universe, and this strange four-dimensional substance controls time, light, and energy; it will also determine how our universe will end.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E03 — Dark History of the Solar System
Our solar system hides a dark and violent past and new discoveries reveal that Earth and the planets were formed from the destruction of alien worlds that came before us.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E08 — Secret Lives of Neutrinos
Neutrinos are the most mysterious particles in the universe, and they power some of the most explosive events in the cosmos; new discoveries reveal how these ghosts pass through objects undetected and why they could be the reason humans exist.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:
S01 E01 — Mystery of the Golden King
Stel and Jess trek to the Black Sea, where they investigate a 7,000-year-old skeleton buried in gold treasure, and uncover evidence of an ancient catastrophe that could be the basis for Noah's flood and the destruction of Atlantis.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:
S01 E05 — Island of Rings
Stel and Jess search underwater ruins off the coast of Greece that could be the ruins of Atlantis.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:
S01 E06 — Pyramid at Sea
Stel and Jess investigate a mysterious Greek island where an advanced ancient civilization built a massive marble pyramid.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:
S01 E02 — Legend of the Adriatic
Stel and Jess dig into unexplored archeological sites along the Adriatic coast of Croatia where underwater relics from an ancient bridge system lead them to an age-old legend of a lost city and into a massive sinkhole that could swallow a city whole.

title: Hunting Atlantis
description:
S01 E04 — Sicily's Secrets
Stel and Jess sail to Sicily to explore Europe's largest active volcano; their investigation leads them to a hidden labyrinth and a mysterious underwater monolith.

title: Hunting Atlantis

Stel and Jess investigate cave paintings in Turkey that match an advanced civilization that built the world's oldest city; tracing the ancient migration to the coast, they discover a shoreline and ruins of a lost city right under their feet.

description:
S01 E05 — Attack at Sea
The aerial bombardment of the Japanese fleet and the torpedo strike of the Wilhelm Gustloff are two of the most shocking attacks of WWII; expert divers explore these underwater graveyards for new evidence of these maritime conflicts.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E02 — Danger Ahead
The enigmatic shipwrecks of El Faro and the Empress of Ireland occurred a century apart and both remain a mystery of the sea; armed with the latest technology, experts explore these doomed ships to discover what set them on the path to catastrophe.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E08 — Collision Course
Three historical collisions expose the volatile risks at sea and how they have shaped the technological advancements of today; now, maritime researchers explore the remnants of these shipwrecks to uncover what happened in their fatal, final moments.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E07 — Lost Fleet of WWI
More than 50 massive warships were lost in a matter of hours in the Scottish natural harbor of Scapa Flow during World War I; now, marine archaeologists use cutting-edge technology to explore one of the greatest acts of defiance in wartime history.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E10 — Scotland's Sea Secrets
For over a century, the stories and wrecks of HMS Hampshire and HMS Vanguard continue to be shrouded in mystery; two research teams are granted special access to investigate and uncover what happened to these WWI warships in their final moments.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E01 — Nuclear Wrecks
The remains of five warships could reveal new insights into how the nuclear arms race changed the world forever; using 3-D sonar scan technology, an expert team of marine scientists investigate the catastrophic effects of atomic explosions at sea.

title: Abandoned: Expedition Shipwreck
description:
S01 E09 — Toxic Wrecks
As shipwrecks of World War II continue to erode in the sea, their toxic cargoes continue to pose a catastrophic threat; now, experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate and reveal the potential impact of these noxious underwater dangers.

Gravitational waves are helping scientists explore the cosmos in revolutionary, new ways, and the discoveries they make are revealing the universe's greatest mysteries.

A Russian radio station has broadcast a signal nonstop since the Cold War, and no one knows why; experts use hi-tech methods to investigate what it is and what might happen if it ever stops.

S01 E05 — The Ghost on the Radio
When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

title: Phantom Signals
description:

description:

When two experts build their own radio-listening station to intercept the secret communications of American and Soviet astronauts, they capture traces of a haunting voice that may be a lost Russian cosmonaut.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E07 — Omen of the Pharaoh's Wail
Experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate a mysterious phenomenon at the tomb of a 3,000-year-old Egyptian pharaoh.

When a U.S. Air Force intercept aircraft chases after a UFO, it vanishes forever without a trace; a new investigation tries to uncover what caused this mysterious disappearance.

Security cameras capture a baby stroller pushed by a mysterious force across a London subway platform and crash onto the tracks; experts investigate and uncover a disturbing history of paranormal incidents surrounding London's subway system.

A security camera captures panic in Lima, Peru, as a wave of fire chases terrified citizens down a city street claiming 30 lives; experts uncover reports of a disastrous fuel tanker accident with an inadequate and fatal safety response.

A village mourner at an Indonesian funeral films a dead man's hand waving through the glass window of a coffin; experts investigate and uncover powerful local priests and the practice of black magic rituals to reanimate corpses back from the dead.

New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

description:
S09 E03 — Secrets of the Sun
A brand-new NASA mission to the sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the sun's atmosphere, its findings challenge everything known about this strange place.

S08 E06 — When NASA Met Jupiter
NASA's Juno spacecraft is part of a cutting-edge mission to explore the mysteries of Jupiter; as this mighty probe is pummeled with deadly radiation, it gathers new data that could change everything we know about the solar system's biggest planet.

description:

In order to build a colossal airplane, the crew needs to gather parts from around the world; three dump trucks need to be shipped.

description:

In Louisiana, tons of biofuel is destined for a power plant across the Atlantic; a ship loader dangles in the sky; a faulty radio could squash the operation.

Shippers in Virginia have a few hours to move 5,700 tons of cargo onto a barge, but a thunderstorm threatens the chances of completing the task; one of the world's largest cruise ships needs to restock.

NASA plans to send humans to Mars within just 15 years, but to reach this next frontier of space exploration, experts must discover new technology and cutting-edge science that protects astronauts from the Red Planet's deadliest killers.

S01 E03 — Knights Templar in America
New evidence suggests the Knights Templar fled Europe and rebuilt their warrior order in the Americas a century before Christopher Columbus; experts use technology to investigate long-lost relics to see if they confirm this game-changing theory.
